_comment: Synthetic offline baseline of expected processes for demo purposes, keyed by lowercase process name.

known_bad.powershell.exe: Frequently abused for encoded/obfuscated execution; treat command line as high-signal.
known_bad.mimikatz.exe: Well-known credential-dumping tool; presence alone is a critical indicator.
known_bad.psexec.exe: Common lateral-movement tool; expected only from authorized admin workstations.
known_bad.certutil.exe: Living-off-the-land binary frequently abused to download or decode payloads.
